rows.title: The germinal products set asks transit countries for rail and road, with the same page, list, cap and overview task as live animals
rows.detail: The germinal products set takes live animals as its reference point for everything, and the data dictionary marks transit countries for germinal products as well as animals. So a germinal products notification whose means of transport is rail or road is asked which countries the consignment travels through, on a page that asks the same question with the same country list, the same twelve-country cap and the same rules as the live animals page, and its overview shows the matching task while it applies.
acceptanceCriteria: Save and continue on a germinal products notification's arrival details opens its transit countries page when the means of transport is Rail or Road, and the transporter list when it is Air or Sea. (ruling:sam-2026-11-10 ruling-sam-2026-11-10-p1-002, -p1-009; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p2-183; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p11-043)

The germinal products transit countries page has the heading 'Which countries will the consignment travel through?', the caption 'Movement' and the browser tab title 'Transit countries - Import notification service - GOV.UK', and opens straight on a country search labelled 'Enter a country' with the hint 'Enter each country that the consignment will travel through'. (ruling:sam-2026-11-10 ruling-sam-2026-11-10-p1-002; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p11-053)

Opening or posting a germinal products notification's transit countries page when its saved means of transport is Air or Sea, or none is chosen, shows the notification overview. (ruling:sam-2026-11-10 ruling-sam-2026-11-10-p1-002; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p11-043)

The germinal products transit country search offers the same countries and subdivisions as the live animals one, each subdivision labelled '<territory> (<parent>)', in alphabetical order by that label. (ruling:sam-2026-11-10 ruling-sam-2026-11-10-p1-002, -p1-009; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p11-053)

Added germinal transit countries are listed in a table headed 'Country', one row per country in the order added, each with a Remove control whose accessible name is 'Remove <country>', and they are listed again in that order when the trader returns to the page. (ruling:sam-2026-11-10 ruling-sam-2026-11-10-p1-002; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p11-053)

Once twelve germinal transit countries are added, the page shows 'Maximum of 12 countries reached. Remove a country to add another.' in place of the search and the Add country button, and saving more than twelve is refused with 'Select up to 12 countries'. (ruling:sam-2026-11-10 ruling-sam-2026-11-10-p1-002, -p1-009; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p11-053)

Save and continue on the germinal products transit countries page with no country added goes to the transporter list, as it does with countries added. (ruling:sam-2026-11-10 ruling-sam-2026-11-10-p1-002; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p11-053)

Saving a germinal products notification's arrival details with the means of transport Air or Sea clears its saved transit countries, so the transit countries page shows an empty list when the means of transport is next changed to Rail or Road. (ruling:sam-2026-11-10 ruling-sam-2026-11-10-p1-002; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p11-043)

A germinal products notification's overview shows a 'Transit countries' task between 'Arrival details' and 'Transport details' while its saved means of transport is Rail or Road, reading 'To do' with no country added and 'Complete' once one is. (ruling:sam-2026-11-10 ruling-sam-2026-11-10-p1-002, -p1-009; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p2-183, -p2-184)

sources.ref: repo-frontend-p11-043, -p11-053 (the live-animals transit countries page and its rail-or-road condition)

rows.notes: One slice: the germinal set's transit countries page, the condition that shows it and its overview task share one page and one obligation, so building them apart would repeat the same set-up. It restates, for the whole requirement, what the existing germinal row already says of the transit countries page and task: the combiner should fold this draft into inc-182, adding req-2631 to its requirements and keeping only the criteria inc-182 does not already state (the list, the cap, optional saving and clearing on Air or Sea). c-469 is ruled: the 10 November ruling breaks the data dictionary's tie, so the germinal set asks transit countries on the same rail-or-road condition as live animals. The germinal set does not exist yet, so its pages are copies of the live-animals transport pages, which the arrival-and-transit split theme changes first; inc-182 already waits on that branch's rows through externalDependsOn.

splitOff.why: It is template mode on arrival details, the parked templates work that branch holds alongside the other arrival details template-mode requirements; it stays blocked there until the owner picks templates up again.

Its return controls go to the template review page, which that branch's templates and template-review code owns, and it is parked template-mode wording held with the other arrival details template-mode requirements; it stays blocked there until the owner picks templates up again.
